liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue up by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

With total debt of {{total_debt@FY2024}} and the interest-bearing financial liabilities fully repaid, the cash pile covers the group's borrowings outright, so near-term maturities do not depend on new funding.
Free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2024}} to {{net_capex@FY2024}}.

watch_items.text: Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, in the middle of the peer group, and net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2024}} to {{net_capex@FY2024}}.

Cash flow after leases: free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, so the cash left for debt holders narrowed even with net cash on the balance sheet.
Traffic: growth of {{traffic_growth@FY2024}} was below the peer median of {{traffic_growth.peer_median@FY2024}} and the weakest of the group ({{traffic_growth.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

Regulation: airport charges are temporarily adjusted by average inflation, a rule that ends at the end of 2026, so aeronautical revenue per passenger of {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}} depends on the tariff framework that follows.
